basis.exploratory_spending_gate: warmup99 exceeds each control by >0.005 WP; not a significance or generalization threshold

design_findings.common_capacity_control: All arms use the same 336-to-64 GELU model and cloned initialization. The first 224 input weights and head are shared; the added 112 weights start exactly zero, making initial outputs equal. A receives exact-zero side input; B receives duplicated current raw112; C receives the fixed per-sequence FP64 mean of raw[0:99], cast to FP32 and broadcast only from t>=99.
design_findings.normalization_and_causality: One fit-row-only R7 normalizer is shared by all arms. Its raw112 mean/scale is applied identically to B current raw112 and C warmup mean; do not fit context-specific statistics. Force every side block to exact zero at t<99 after transforms. The original masks/stride stay unchanged and eligible scored rows must all satisfy t>=99. Context uses only each sequence's first 99 raw input rows, with no labels, seq_ix, future rows, future masks, or evaluation-derived statistics.
design_findings.fixed_training_budget: Each arm makes 12 epochs over all 31,808 fit rows: 381,696 row exposures and 756 attempted/successful updates per arm; 1,145,088 total exposures and 2,268 total updates. The shared epoch permutation, optimizer, objective, clipping, and numerical mode are fixed. Any incomplete or nonfinite arm makes the comparison incomplete; no retry or replacement seed.
design_findings.metric_and_claim_boundary: The final comparison uses the unchanged canonical global_wp_clip2_v1 scorer on the original 32 evaluation masks. The screen can prioritize a later ordered/recurrent context test only if the predeclared gate clears; it cannot establish GRU benefit, a serving gain, public/full-fold performance, or population significance. The first-99 mean discards order, represents 64 fit-sequence summaries rather than 31,808 independent contexts, and may behave as a sequence/component signature. One seed and the exposed panel are exploratory evidence. A negative result addresses this fixed prefix-mean recipe only.

review_scope: Prospective design review only. No R13 source, data arrays, model, or outcome was inspected or executed.
implementation_gate: Before admission, independently verify the frozen code and source pins, exact initialization/output parity, context boundaries and future-perturbation/sequence-reset invariants, fit-only shared normalization, unchanged membership/masks, common order/update counts, zero-anchor and unused-head invariants, finite canonical scoring, complete cold-import/read-sentinel closure, and bounded runtime/resource guards.
